Triage: lands in `domain:spec` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:data · Bug · Impeded (`userActions.exportCsv: false` is offered in the Studio object form but no export menu reads it, so the switch does nothing) · builders, often (the object form) · measured `dead` in the liveness ledger → p2 as set. Route per ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove.

repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvvVzM5KhCWkT5f45c

Ruling · 2026-11-20T09:18Z: **Enforce.** The maintainer (Tesla) picked the enforce route on seat 7's decision card (2026-11-20T09:18Z; card question 「对象上的"禁止导出 CSV"开关(exportCsv)要落实还是删掉?」, option 「落实开关」).

So this card takes ADR-0049's enforce route, as its Done-when describes. The export surfaces read the resolved `exportCsv` bit: ObjectGrid, ListView, RelatedList and ReportExport, plus a spec resolver if needed. There is a pin that `exportCsv: false` hides export on a grid and a list view, and a CONTROL that the default still shows it. The ledger row moves to `live`. It touches non-test `packages/spec/src` and `ui/**`, so it is a big card for its own card thread. Seat 7 queues it for the next free card-thread slot.

- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/` (`managedBy.ts` / `affordanceGrants.ts`: one resolved export verdict the surfaces read).
- The four export surfaces: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExport.tsx` (and their direct schema plumbing if the object schema must reach them).
- New pin files named for 35619 beside each touched surface; changesets for each touched published package.
Stop on any breach and explain it in the report.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:subagent` (this card thread is the seat's `mode:thread` slot), `model: default` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: no path-derived mandate; Clause-② suspect line for `packages/spec/src/**`, judged below), `effort: xhigh` (reason: seat 7 card order card-35619.md 2026-11-21 「one os-dev (xhigh: spec contract)」)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Responsibility: `objectstack platform: resolveCrudAffordances copies userActions.exportCsv onto CrudAffordances.exportCsv and no console export entry reads that bit | none: the export entries gate on exportOptions, operations.export, allowExport and the effective export operation only | builders who set exportCsv:false in the Studio object form, often; today it does nothing`
Thread-read: 7035537883
Ruling-ref: 7035537883 — "**Enforce.** The maintainer (Tesla) picked the enforce route on seat 7's decision card"
Premise: holds. At `origin/main` 8145424b: `resolveCrudAffordances` (object.zod.ts, `exportCsv: overrides.exportCsv ?? base.exportCsv`) emits the bit; `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances` (ui core managedBy.ts) only ANDs it with the effective `export` operation; `AFFORDANCE_GRANTS` (affordanceGrants.ts) has no export row; ObjectGrid's `handleExport` gates on `schema.operations?.export` and `effectiveApiOps`, ListView's `exportPermitted` on `allowExport`, `operations.export` and `effectiveApiOps`, ReportExport on `getObjectApiOperations(snapshot.object)` only. Ledger row `props.userActions.children.exportCsv` reads `dead`.
Clause-② reading: enforcing the bit hides an entry the console showed; the schema accepts exactly what it accepted, and no new key or value is declared, so the accept set neither widens nor narrows. If the build adds a name or union member reachable from a published entry (e.g. a new `ConsoleAffordance` row), the dev measures it on the built declaration closure and reports it; the seat then re-files this line as `yes`.
Serial constraints cleared: none. overlap-check at claim (empty change set) clean; it runs again before each push. d7-E's in-flight #35798 is `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`, disjoint from `RelatedList.tsx`.
Pre-claim lane: seat 7, card thread c-35619 (domain:spec card with `ui/**` remainder; area-lease 留道: stays in this lane, L1 by L1-a, L2 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`). Governed paths: none.
Pre-claim deps: none named; parent #35401 is closed and PR #35583 merged.
Prior rulings read: ADR grep `exportCsv` → ADR-0103 (bucket defaults, `exportCsv: true` in every bucket) and ADR-0153 (`engine-owned` default `exportCsv` true): both kept, enforcement reads the same defaults. `check-prior-rulings.mjs` on the face: 190 ⛔ lines over object.zod.ts, object.json, ObjectGrid.tsx, ListView.tsx; one mentions export (ObjectGrid.tsx 661, an exported-type note, not this gate); RelatedList.tsx 13 ⛔ lines, none on export; ReportExport.tsx, managedBy.ts, affordanceGrants.ts none. No conflict with the ENFORCE ruling.
